purpose: Candidate indicator definitions for Financial Inclusion & Poverty Reduction; no entries are currently approved for calculation or publication.
global_limitations: No codebook with verified variable semantics is currently available in the project.
Local source authorization and licensing remain unverified.
No indicator in this catalogue should be calculated from the local microdata until evidence and domain review are complete.
Separate surveys must not be linked at household level without documented authorization and compatible linkage identifiers.

indicators.description: Candidate concept for access to a formal financial service; not an implemented or verified estimate.
indicators.policy_question: Which population groups face limited access to formal financial services?
indicators.missing_value_treatment: To be defined from an authorized codebook and questionnaire review.
indicators.survey_weight_requirements: A dataset-specific survey weight must be identified and reviewed before estimation.
indicators.calculation_method: Blocked until numerator, denominator, variable coding, and survey design are verified.
interpretation_cautions: Do not infer formal access from a variable name alone.
Do not compare surveys without a documented harmonization method.
